desc:
In a world where a virus has turned most people into zombies, a small military base is fighting for survival. There is rumor that a scientific research facility has found a cure, but who knows when it will reach this remote valley...

[New Special Forces Gamepass] 
- Unlocks the AK-104
- Get the Special Forces morph
- Access to the new attack helicopter with onboard grenade launcher

💵 Earn money by shooting the dead and going on missions
🔫 Visit the gun store to purchase new weapons
📌 Fly helicopters and drive Humvee's to explore the map
🕹️ Remember to invite your friends

🚁 Helicopter controls: WASD, E - Up, Q - Down.

💾 This game has autosave
